message:
fix(context): retain returned outcomes when approval bridging fails

The joined executor may return a real receipt while an unrelated approval-control error aborts the run. Preserve and checkpoint that result before returning the original bridge failure; if persistence also fails, keep both errors. No authorization change or automatic retry.

The real-gate regression failed before the fix with one intent and zero settlements. Full Go 1.27.1 steering/assemble/runctx race suites pass. Cancellation and counter-failure tests verify single execution, exact receipt, identity, a bounded live persistence context and an unlocked inspection mutex. Phase 269 smoke passes 5 OK/0 FAIL; scoped pinned lint, Markdown and whitespace checks pass. Full repository/RC acceptance remains unfinished.
